title: From the Codex beta to AI-native engineering
description: How my work evolved from debugging snippets in a browser to directing agents, building AI applications and taking on larger engineering challenges.

title: How I Used AI to Train for My First Open-Water Podium
description: From swimming to stay active after a back injury to third place in Masters 30 at Blue Arico. What helped, what went wrong and why this was much more than asking a chatbot for a training plan.
